_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Tuesday W17 — heaviest single day of the window. Three capital-formation events + three enterprise-platform launches + the largest tech-history capital raise all in 24 hours. (1) Sundar Pichai opens Google Cloud Next 2026 in Vegas: $70B Cloud annual revenue at 48% growth, $240B backlog, 750M Gemini users; 75% of new Google code is AI-generated; recent internal migration ran 6x faster with agents — Google reframes as 'the OS for agents'. (2) Anthropic + Google + Broadcom: 3.5GW of TPU compute through Broadcom-designed silicon online 2027 — pairs with Monday's 5GW AWS deal to give Anthropic ~8.5GW total across two clouds; disclosure re-states $30B+ run-rate revenue (up from ~$9B end-2025) and 1,000+ customers at >$1M annualised (doubled in <2 months). (3) OpenAI closes $122B at $750B primary + secondary tender — explicitly tagged for compute capex through 2028, largest single capital raise in tech history. (4) Snowflake AI Pulse: Cortex Agents gains MCP connectors for Gmail/Calendar/Docs/Jira/Salesforce/Slack; Cortex Code SDK adds AWS Glue + Databricks + Postgres connectors and native VS Code + Claude Code integration; Snowflake Intelligence adds Skills; Python/TypeScript Agent SDK; Cortex AI Guardrails. Most Anthropic-friendly statement any data cloud has made in 2026. (5) Workday — Illuminate platform of agents (Josh Bersin long-form) formal pivot from 'system of record' to 'platform of agents' ahead of Workday Rising. (6) Google Deep Research Max bundled with Gemini Enterprise. (7) MIT Technology Review '10 Things That Matter in AI Right Now' lands annual feature on Cloud-Next day-1. Best long-form: Willison's hands-on with ChatGPT Images 2.0 (gpt-image-1 to gpt-image-2 = GPT-3 to GPT-5 per Altman) + Andreas Påhlsson-Notini 'Less human AI agents, please' (current agents drift to the familiar under awkward tasks and 'start negotiating with reality' under hard constraints — anthropomorphic failure mode is the clean frame for harness-engineering). Research: Agent-World scaling environment synthesis, On the Reliability of Computer Use Agents, Symbolic Guardrails domain-specific agents, Terminal Wrench 331 reward-hackable environments + 3,632 exploit trajectories, EvoMaster autonomous-scientific-agent framework, GenericAgent token-efficient self-evolving via contextual density, SkillFlow lifelong skill-evolution benchmark. STAGE MOVES: agent-platforms-enterprise (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Day-2 wave); lab-services-gtm crosses higher (~$122B + 3.5GW + Snowflake Cortex Code + Workday Illuminate channel commit); 'Frontier lab compute pacts' cluster widens (Anthropic-Google-Broadcom 3.5GW + OpenAI $122B raise).
